displayName: JCPenney Product Data API - Clearance, Coupons, Store Stock
description: JCPenney product data as structured JSON - search jcpenney.com or browse any category, a brand, or the Clearance, Sale, Black Friday, Big Buy, Limited Time Special, Closeout and Buy 1 Get 1 deal lists, 48 products per page (up to 25 pages) with the current and regular price range, price type (sale, clearance, original), percent off, deal label, the price after today's coupon with the coupon code, rating, review count, badge and colors, filtered by brand, color, size, price range, deal label or any facet (store pickup, rating, gender...); read one product with every variant's SKU, UPC, color, size and online stock, or up to 20 products in one call; get real unit counts for one SKU at the 5 nearest stores to a ZIP; find stores with hours and services; pull search suggestions and today's public JCPenney coupon codes; read real review text (sorted most recent, most helpful, highest or lowest rating, or relevance, optionally one star rating) with verified, incentivized and syndicated badges, photos, the brand's reply and Quality / Value ratings, and customer questions with every answer labelled brand, JCPenney staff, AI or customer. 11 endpoints, 1 credit each.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
